articles.title: Tiny 'Hobbit' People Walked Like Us — New Hip Bone Clues
articles.summary: Scientists studied the hip bones of a tiny extinct 'hobbit' and found it walked upright like humans! The hobbit was only about 3.5 feet tall and lived on an Indonesian island.

articles.title: Teen Scientists Get to Use a Giant Particle Smasher!
articles.summary: Six high school students from India won a contest to do a real experiment at CERN, the world's biggest particle physics lab. An MIT grad student helped them along the way.

articles.title: Farewell to Jackie, the Famous Bald Eagle of Big Bear
articles.summary: Jackie, the beloved bald eagle from Big Bear Valley, California, died on August 10, 2026. She was about 14. Millions watched her and her mate Shadow on a live webcam.
